title: Manager: small fixes left by task 061 (job b worktree, main-folder during a merge, rebuilt task's two worktrees, tests that read limits.json, a check on builder spend)
item: Fix the minor problems review 061-1 and advisor 061-1 left in the parallel manager, and add a script check for money a builder spends when its task has no outside_needs or cap
motivation: Review 061-1 minor 1-8 and advisor 061-1's notes; none blocked task 61. The task 61 builder spent about 0.59 USD on claude -p runs with no money field on the task: rule 2 says a broken rule that no script checks gets a task to build that check.
notes: Review 061-1: (1) step 8's job (b) brief does not pass the task's worktree that agents/advisor.md expects; (2) main-folder fails on a staged change, so running it while a step-7 merge --no-commit is open (a background builder returning mid-merge) ends the run with the merge open; the text should say to wait until the merge is committed or aborted; (3) after a failed main-folder check the text says change nothing on the working branch, but step 9 commits RUNS.md, and nothing covers agents still running; (4) a park removes one worktree, but a rebuilt task has two; (5) your own commit or tracked edit in the main folder during a run ends the run, and no doc tells you; (6) test_batch_hard_dependency_between_tasks's batch assertion passes without the dependency check; (7) tasks_at_once is not validated (0 or missing); (8) advisor.md's Never list does not name conflict and stale. Advisor 061-1: test_limits_tasks_at_once_starts_at_2 and the parallel test read the real limits.json, so they fail when you change tasks_at_once; SKILL.md rule 8 overstates the isolation: "worktree" result. Builder: the push hook refuses any Bash text containing the words of a push, even in a heredoc that writes docs; skill-iterate's commands/iterate.md still assumes the main folder (another skill); tasks.py next is kept beside batch.
draft_note: Drafted by the manager on 2026-11-17 from review 061-1, advisor 061-1 and the task 061 builder's notes.
